body.x: IT HEALTH (CEO Bae Yoon-seop, www.ezsensor.com) showcased its ‘UrinCare’, a smart urine and feces management system, in the joint pavilion of the Mobile Technology Convergence Center (MTCC) at the world’s best IT technology exhibition ‘CES(Consumer Technology Show) 2016’ which runs Jan. 6-9 in Las Vegas Convention Center(LVCC).
UrinCare is a system that lets nurses and guardians know when seniors and disabled people wearing a diaper with a sensor urinate or defecate.
The system consists of a urine and feces detecting sensor, a diaper, a sensing system, an alarm system, and a smartphone application.
The IoT-based lamp system BioRay was showcased together. It is an LED system suitable for sanatoriums. It enables users to manage and control lighting by using a smartphone.

IT HEALTH CEO Bae Yoon-seop said: “Along with the rapidly increasing elderly population, we are happy to introduce IoT-based products that can improve their quality of life. We will advance into not only domestic but also global markets, with our smart systems for sanatoriums and homes.”

The company develops sensor systems based on sensors and sensor signal process technology and smart energy systems related to LED and streetlights. It is developing user-customized products by utilizing various technologies for signal processes, micro module development, systems, and smartphone apps.

DIP prepared the joint pavilion at this exhibition and supported related domestic companies’ participation in CES 2016, promoting the reinforcement project for quality capability of the smart knowledge service, which is a promotional project for regional-specialized businesses supported by the Ministry of Trade, Industry and Energy. It is mainly focused on the competitiveness reinforcement business of new mobile convergence in the global market.

Held annually in January and owned and produced by the Consumer Technology Association (CTA), CES 2016 is the world's largest exhibition to see the latest global trends in electronics and IT industry in one spot.

AVING News has been sending its reporters to CES for 11 years to introduce the new technologies and products. After the local coverage and research, AVING News will hold ‘CES 2016 Review Conference’ in AVING Studio, Korea on January 28th
